content.short: We are a Fair Cardano Stake Pool Explorer, we provided delegators a fairer selection process than any other explorer.
content.description:
We provide delegators a fairer selection process as we do not favoritism large pools, multi-pools, give pools ratings, gold stars or leaderboards. Our Dashboard is the first page any user sees and we have made this dashboard randomly display Stake pools every time to stop any favoritism providing the SPO's an equal chance of being displayed and hopefully gain some delegation.

Once at PoolPeek website delegators can use our pool selection wizard that users can choose between criteria that best meets their requirements for a stake pool selection. We also provide a straight search bar for a quick delegation process if user already know who they wish to delegate to. We provide multiple other useful tools from ISPO offerings, StakePool calculator, Map Search and many more. All are welcome at PoolPeek.com.
